title: Business Gold Rewards Card: Annual Fee and Premium Benefits Guide
summary: This guide covers the Business Gold Rewards Card’s $200.00 annual fee (billed to the primary account each anniversary) and the premium benefits that follow: 9 complimentary lounge visits per account year, $200 annual travel credits, concierge services, and 0% foreign transaction fees. It also explains how travel credits post after eligibility checks and suggests reviewing your statement after the anniversary and setting alerts for large travel purchases.
faqs: When is the Business Gold Rewards Card annual fee charged, and how much is it?
